claim_text: Under operational refinement and class-complete access, exact universal alphabet size equals min_C |C/J|.

claim_text: Full operational collapse, canonicalization or connected robustness closure, and a rigid supported class each leave only the trivial exact message under their stated assumptions.

evidence_type: formal corollaries + checked capacity-collapse instance
limitations: Depends on exact behavior preservation and exact decoder invariance under the declared closure.

claim_text: Without refinement, exact feasibility is equivalent to a polychromatic coloring of the quotient hypergraph.
claim_scope: arbitrary crossing behavioral and operational equivalences with class-complete access
evidence_type: formal iff proof + independently structured finite decoder/solver correspondence
limitations: Coloring may be computationally expensive; positive representatives may be non-effective.

claim_text: Local edge sizes are not sufficient: a three-edge triangle has two cells per behavior class but no exact bit.

evidence_type: counterexample proof + exhaustive coloring search
limitations: Diagnoses the minimal graph obstruction; larger hyperedges admit additional obstructions.

claim_text: After isolated vertices are discarded, every set-sized nonempty-edge hypergraph is realizable by behavioral/operational equivalence incidence; finite capacity is its polychromatic number.

evidence_type: constructive incidence proof + executable reconstruction
raw_result: Fano hypergraph recovered from 21 incidences; binary feasibility=false
limitations: The realization is semantic and does not provide a concrete source-language transformation.

claim_text: For a finite alphabet, failure over a hypergraph whose every individual edge is finite has a finite edge-subfamily witness; allowing an infinite edge can destroy this property.

evidence_type: topological compactness proof + explicit counterexample
proof_or_checker: finite-intersection argument in a product of finite discrete spaces; all-infinite-subsets counterexample
raw_result: finite obstruction exists exactly under stated finite-alphabet/finite-edge hypotheses
limitations: The result is existential and does not compute a smallest obstruction.

claim_text: Finite crossing exact-bit feasibility is NP-complete at three cells per behavior class; the two-cell fragment is graph bipartiteness.

evidence_type: polynomial reduction + graph equivalence
proof_or_checker: incidence reduction from monotone NAE-3SAT; binary edge-coloring argument

claim_scope: arbitrary behavior/operational equivalences and arbitrary declared access relation
evidence_type: formal iff proof + independent finite program-level oracle
limitations: A positive mechanism claim additionally needs sound, constructible representatives for the declared access edges.

claim_text: Finite access-constrained exact-bit feasibility is NP-complete at three reachable cells per source; the two-cell fragment is graph bipartiteness.
